title: Endless Rounds
description: 10-minute AMRAP with goblet squats, Hindu push-ups and Bulgarian split squats to chain as many rounds as possible

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Brisk march in place
exercises.instructions: March briskly in place while swinging your arms

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Goblet squat (no weight)
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of your chest, descend deep

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Diving motion: swoop down then rise up in an arc

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch your feet

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Rear foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
